d: Orbitworks is looking for an IT Administrator to own the systems, networks and technology that support our satellite manufacturing operations.

You will keep our infrastructure reliable, secure and recoverable while providing hands-on IT support across our offices, labs and cleanroom. Your scope will include backup and disaster recovery, connectivity, endpoint management and the technical delivery of business continuity.

This is an individual contributor role with ownership of the IT function and support from external technology and security partners. It suits someone who enjoys working independently, solving practical problems and balancing daily support with longer-term infrastructure improvements.
q: At least 6 years of IT experience, including 2 years owning infrastructure as the primary or sole administrator.
Hands-on experience with backup, disaster recovery and restore testing.
Strong corporate networking skills, including LAN/WAN, VPNs, firewalls and multi-WAN failover.
Experience with single sign-on, mobile device management and access controls across Mac and Windows environments.
Strong troubleshooting skills and the ability to prioritize and resolve issues independently.
Clear written communication, with the ability to produce useful technical documentation and explain risks, progress and recovery readiness to business leaders.
Experience with Cisco Meraki and Synology, including high-availability storage and Active Backup.
Exposure to business continuity programmes or ISO 22301.
Experience supporting manufacturing, laboratory or cleanroom environments.
r: Own IT infrastructure and connectivity: Maintain and troubleshoot networks, firewalls, VPNs and virtualized environments. Manage resilient connectivity across our sites, including multiple internet connections and WAN failover.

Manage backup and disaster recovery: Own backups across virtual machines, Google Workspace, Dropbox and onsite storage. Verify daily completion, resolve failures and maintain offsite and immutable backup copies.
Test recovery and continuity: Run monthly restore drills, isolated cyber recovery testing and quarterly continuity exercises. Document results, address gaps and keep recovery procedures current.

Maintain emergency site readiness: Ensure the alternative operating site has the connectivity, backup access and infrastructure needed to support business continuity. Coordinate IT power resilience with Facilities.
Strengthen security: Work with external security partners to address assessment findings, harden infrastructure and improve access controls, MFA and endpoint security.
Deliver daily IT support: Resolve hardware, software, permissions and collaboration tool issues. Configure and manage Mac and Windows laptops, mobile devices and MDM.
Support employees and technical teams: Coordinate onboarding and offboarding with the People team, maintain meeting room AV systems and support devices used in labs, manufacturing and the cleanroom.

Manage vendors, documentation and reporting: Coordinate external support, maintain runbooks and offline emergency instructions, support audits and provide clear infrastructure and continuity updates to leadership.
Support growth: Deliver infrastructure improvements and help set up new office and lab environments as Orbitworks scales.
x: You’ll own a critical function in a growing satellite manufacturing business, working closely with engineering, industrial operations and business teams. Your work will directly support reliable operations and strengthen our ability to recover from disruption.
As Orbitworks grows, there is an opportunity to develop toward broader IT and security leadership and help build the future IT team.

Orbitworks' mission is to make space simple for organizations that want to deploy physical and virtual missions to space. Building on Loft Orbital's heritage, Orbitworks will be the first commercial firm in the United Arab Emirates to mass-manufacture satellites. Orbitworks aims to manufacture tens of satellites annually and operates out of a 50,000-square-foot facility in Abu Dhabi.

d: Careem is building the Everything App for the greater Middle East — making it easy to move around, order food and groceries, manage payments, and more. Our purpose is simple: to simplify and improve people’s lives and build an awesome organisation that inspires.

Whether it’s streamlining operations, enhancing customer experience, or reimagining internal systems — we want people who can make Careem work smarter and move faster.

This role sits at the intersection of Operations, Care, Product, and Finance — turning business priorities into structured programs, and using data and policy design to make customer experience consistent, efficient, and scalable across every market and business line we operate in.

You'll act as an individual contributor with real strategic influence: owning recurring performance reviews with vertical and market leads, running the analysis that shapes product and commercial roadmaps, and leading the policy decisions that define how the business treats its customers when things go right — and when they don't.
q: Aligns Product, Operations, Care around shared journey-level priorities and drive consistent policy and quality of service.

Develop segment-led (cohort-based) policies that treat customers differently based on value and history, while keeping the system simple enough to operate at scale.
Run the governance forums that keep policy application consistent across markets, and partner with legacy or market-specific teams to bring outlying markets onto a common framework over time.

d: Job Title: Senior Succession Planning Specialist
Work Arrangement: 100% Remote — Work From Home

We are seeking an experienced Senior Succession Planning Specialist to lead and support workforce succession planning, talent assessment coordination, and leadership continuity initiatives. This fully remote position focuses on identifying critical roles, analyzing workforce capabilities, reviewing talent development information, maintaining succession records, and supporting structured talent pipeline strategies. The successful candidate will have strong expertise in human resources, organizational development, talent management, and workforce analytics, with the ability to handle sensitive employee information responsibly and collaborate effectively with senior management and HR teams.
Develop, coordinate, and maintain succession planning frameworks, guidelines, processes, and documentation.
Identify critical business roles and support the assessment of succession risks, workforce dependencies, and leadership continuity requirements.
Coordinate virtual talent review sessions with HR business partners, department leaders, and senior management.
Analyze employee performance information, competency assessments, career aspirations, experience, and development readiness using approved organizational criteria.
Maintain succession plans, talent profiles, critical role inventories, readiness assessments, and development tracking records.
Support the identification of potential successors and the evaluation of capability gaps against future organizational requirements.
Coordinate individual development planning, leadership development initiatives, mentoring programs, and targeted learning activities.
Monitor succession pipeline progress, successor readiness indicators, talent mobility, and development milestones.
Prepare workforce analytics, succession risk reports, talent pipeline dashboards, and management presentations.
Provide analytical support for workforce planning, organizational restructuring, leadership transitions, and talent retention initiatives.
Collaborate virtually with HR teams, learning and development specialists, department heads, and organizational development professionals.
Maintain confidentiality and appropriate access controls for sensitive employee, performance, compensation, and succession information.
Review succession planning procedures and recommend improvements to governance, documentation, assessment consistency, and reporting quality.
Support internal audits and HR governance reviews by maintaining accurate records and supporting evidence.
Monitor developments in talent management, leadership development, workforce planning, and succession planning practices.
Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, Organizational Psychology, Management, or a related discipline. A postgraduate qualification is an advantage.
Substantial experience in succession planning, talent management, organizational development, workforce planning, or strategic HR.
Strong understanding of succession planning methodologies, competency frameworks, leadership assessment, and talent development practices.
Experience identifying critical roles, assessing succession risks, coordinating talent reviews, and maintaining succession pipelines.
Familiarity with workforce analytics, performance management systems, HR information systems, and talent management platforms.
Strong analytical, strategic thinking, communication, and organizational skills.
Ability to interpret workforce data and translate findings into practical recommendations.
Excellent stakeholder management and presentation skills, including experience engaging with senior leadership.
High standards of confidentiality, impartiality, professional integrity, and attention to detail.
Ability to manage multiple projects, sensitive information, and competing deadlines independently in a fully remote environment.
A 100% remote working arrangement, with no routine office attendance required.
Full-time employment with opportunities for professional development.
Exposure to strategic HR, organizational development, and leadership continuity initiatives.
A collaborative virtual working environment with cross-functional stakeholders.
Opportunities to influence talent development, workforce resilience, and organizational effectiveness.
A professional environment that values confidentiality, fairness, accountability, and continuous learning.
Interested candidates should submit an updated CV highlighting relevant succession planning, talent management, workforce analytics, and organizational development experience.
Application Subject: Application – Senior Succession Planning Specialist (UAE Remote)
Candidates should confirm applicable employment arrangements, residency requirements, and work authorization before accepting an offer.

Any required in-person assessment activities, physical document verification, or local workforce consultations must be conducted by qualified local personnel.
